notes.title: First Update!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

Here is our first major update. We still have a lot of work ahead, but we’ve already accomplished a lot:
[list]
[*][b]1. Modes[/b]
[list]
[*]Completely redesigned: after you level up in the first mode, all upgrades are saved and become available in the “Challenge” mode.
[*]The “Challenge” mode currently uses temporary enemy spawn logic, but we’ll radically overhaul it soon.
[/list]
[*][b]2. Leaderboards[/b]
[list]
[*]Steam integration: your account nickname is pulled automatically — no more manual entry required.
[/list]
[*][b]3. UI[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated interface — this is still a temporary version. A full redesign is on the way, so don’t be surprised when you see a brand-new look.
[/list]
[*][b]4. Localization[/b]
[list]
[*]English version added. You can now choose between Russian and English in the settings.
[/list]
[*][b]5. Bug Fixes & Mechanics[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed numerous bugs across various parts of the game.
[*]Added new enemy spawn mechanics: the wave sequence and internal wave logic have been updated.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]What’s next?[/b]
[list]
[*]Preparing a major overhaul of the “Challenge” mode with a new enemy spawn system.
[*]Continuing to improve the UI, balance, and game mechanics based on your feedback.
[/list]
Thanks for helping us make the game better! We look forward to your impressions, suggestions, and any bugs you find. Enjoy the game! 🎉

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hi everyone![/b][/p][p]Here’s a quick update on what we’ve been working on over the past few days:[/p][hr][/hr][p]⚙️ [b]Progression System Reworked[/b]
The game structure is now clearly split into two modes:[/p][list][*][p]In the [b]first mode[/b], you fight through waves and pick upgrades between them — this is where your build is formed.[/p][/*][*][p]In the [b]second mode[/b], you play with the build you've crafted in the first — this is part of the metagame progression.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630797/88d555c7875ff3597d85f3606413d8b1eac644c5.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]🖼 [b]UI Improvements[/b]
Upgrades are now displayed in a clean and clear interface directly in-game.[/p][p]What used to be just lines of text is now a proper UI with icons and counters.
You’ll also see your build in the menu when playing the second mode.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630797/2953ca3b7c03bdbf1cb6699d3eb0121f8cd729d3.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]🐛 [b]New Enemy – Small and Fast[/b]
We’ve added a new bug enemy — even smaller and faster than the previous ones.
It fits the game’s pace perfectly and demands more precise aiming.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630797/a04dcca34ba781ccd8ef83d6ee2ee2cf3a4f1638.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]💾 [b]Save System[/b]
A full save system has been implemented, storing your progress (including upgrades) in local files.[/p][p]Automatic loading and saving is now in place — your data is safely kept between sessions.
There’s also a [b]reset progress[/b] button, so you can start fresh at any time.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630797/58119df5446c6c0de7301a41ddfd6a2270d08a3d.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thanks for following the development!
If you have ideas or feedback — drop them in the discussions, we’d love to hear your thoughts.[/p]

notes.title: Дневник разработки #1
notes.notes:
[p]🛠 [b]Preparing a Major Update[/b]
We’re currently working on a big update that we plan to release in about a week or a week and a half. It should significantly improve many of the game’s current issues — we hope it’ll make the experience noticeably smoother and more engaging.[/p][p]Now, a bit about what we’re working on right now…[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630797/52e2f72683af1160d7a754a3873628efd3a773e9.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]📝 [b]Localization System[/b]
Lately, I’ve been working on building a localization system for our game. We’ve implemented text loading directly from a Google Sheet — the data is automatically converted into JSON and imported into the game. This makes managing text much easier and allows us to scale the project to multiple languages with minimal effort.[/p][p]At the moment, everything is working at a basic level, but the system already supports adding 5 to 10 languages without much hassle. It’s a solid foundation for the future.[/p][p]There are some issues with text scaling — in some places the font breaks the layout, in others the buttons don’t fit. But we’re not fixing that just yet: we’re planning a full UI overhaul soon, including both the main and in-game menus. There’s no point in polishing what’s going to change anyway.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630797/dde77d96bc1b56675f9cf47570e33d15cfd70701.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]🎮 [b]Plans for Game Modes[/b]
We’re also planning a complete redesign of the game modes. They’ll become interconnected: we’ll introduce out-of-level progression and meta-progression for the second mode. But more on that later — once we have something to show.[/p][hr][/hr][p]📘 [b]Tutorial Incoming[/b]
We’re definitely adding a tutorial in the upcoming update. Right now, I think many players just don’t understand what to do or what to click. That needs to be addressed immediately — and it’s one of our top priorities.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🏆 [b]Leaderboards & Settings[/b]
Today, I added several new leaderboards — now each game mode has its own. There are also separate entry pages for each mode.[/p][p]In addition, I’ve added a settings page. Players will be able to choose the language, adjust sensitivity, and tweak other options. Bit by bit, the game is becoming more accessible and user-friendly.[/p]
